sanitize_patterns: sanitize user data_files input into a split name to list of patterns dictionary
resolve_pattern: resolve a glob pattern like star star dot csv to matching file paths in a directory
get_data_patterns: auto detect default train validation test split patterns from a dataset directory
DataFilesList_from_local_or_remote: build a data files list from glob patterns with origin metadata for caching
DataFilesDict_from_local_or_remote: build a split name to data files dictionary from patterns for a local or remote path
